title: 第2101章 我很期待哦第2100章 我有一条妙计
slug: 漂亮后妈要翻身我在七零养崽崽
content_zh:
距离此处几里地开外的一栋居民楼上。
女人接到丈夫的电话时，脸色不太好看：“应荣，你都已经好几天没回家了。
现在那三个人不是已经抓到了吗？你们这些警察怎么还要加班？”
许应荣在电话里叹了口气，一副哄孩子的语气：“亲爱的，我也不是不想回去呀。
我这不是刚刚被提拔成了副局长吗？
怎么也得好好表现表现，而且那三个人今天才抓到，我们还有很多工作要做。
你乖乖听话，先陪着孩子好好睡觉好吗？”
女人郁闷地撅了下嘴，还是妥协了：“好吧，我知道了。
那你要小心哦。”
“放心吧，不会有事的。
你好好睡觉，明天一早我就回去了。”
“好。”
女人挂断电话，看看时间已经不晚了。
她先去看了看儿子，确定他已经睡着了，这才回了卧室上床睡觉。
关掉台灯，闭上眼睛没一会就进入了梦乡。
女人也不知怎么回事，以前如果丈夫不在家或者回来的晚，她都会辗转很长时间才能入睡，可今晚一闭眼便睡沉了。
窗户的门被人很快打开，两个黑影翻窗而入。
……
许应荣一直是龙子轩身边的得力手下，也是个出色的队长。
龙子轩在这次港城的学生事件中立了大功，许应荣也是个功臣之一。

所以在龙子轩被提拔成警察局长之后，在龙子轩的力荐下，他被提拔成了警察局的副局长。
这几天他都非常得兴奋，今天晚上抓住了那三个人，更是要把工作做好。
眼看着时间到了凌晨的三点钟，办公桌上的电话突然间响了。
正在躺着睡觉的许应荣腾地起身抓起话筒放到了耳边：“你好，这里是警察局！”
“你好，我找许应荣副局长，请问他在吗？”
对方倒是很客气，许应荣松了口气，刚才还以为是发生了什么大事，他坐下来道：“我就是，你有什么事吗？怎么这个时间打电话？”
“许应荣，我找的就是你！
你想听听你老婆的声音吗？”
电话里突然传来一个哭泣的女人的喊声：“应荣……是我……呜呜……你快来救我……”
许应荣腾地站了起来：“你是谁？你在我家？”
对方冷笑了一声：“许应荣，你现在最好按我说的做。
否则我不介意明天早上让你收到妻子的一根手指！”
“你你你……你别乱来呀……你你你想怎么样？”
许应荣紧张地握着话筒，有些慌乱。
“我想怎么样取决于你接下来的行动。”
“行动？什么行动？”
“很简单，把你们今天抓到的三个人当中的一个，穿上你们警察的衣服给我带出来！
不能让守在外面的苏灿和她手下的人认出来！
如果你做的不好，那你妻子就别想活着离开我这里了！”
“你你你……你别乱来呀！

我告诉你，如果我妻子有任何事我不会放过你的！”
许应荣接电话的时候，龙子轩正好进来找他说事情。
听到他的反应立即走到了他身边，用极低的声音道：“怎么回事？”
许应荣正不知该怎么回答时，就听到电话里的人道：“对了，你现在把你的上司龙子轩叫过来接电话，我告诉他一个好消息！
content_en:
A few miles away from here is a residential building.
When the woman received the call from her husband, her face looked unhappy: "Ying Rong, you haven't been home for several days.
Haven't those three people been caught now? Why do you police officers have to work overtime? "
Xu Yingrong sighed on the phone, with a coaxing tone: "Dear, it's not that I don't want to go back.
Didn't I just get promoted to deputy director?
We have to perform well no matter what, and those three people were just caught today. We still have a lot of work to do.
Please be obedient and have a good sleep with your child first, okay? "
The woman pouted depressedly, but still compromised: "Okay, I understand.
Then be careful. "
"Don't worry, nothing will happen.
You have a good sleep, I will go back early tomorrow morning. "
"Okay."
The woman hung up the phone and looked to see that it was already getting late.
She first checked on her son to make sure he was asleep, and then went back to the bedroom and went to bed.
I turned off the desk lamp, closed my eyes and soon fell asleep.
The woman didn't know what was going on. In the past, if her husband was not at home or came back late, she would toss and turn for a long time before she could fall asleep, but tonight she fell asleep as soon as she closed her eyes.
The door to the window was quickly opened, and two black figures climbed through the window and entered.
…
Xu Yingrong has always been Long Zixuan's right-hand man and an excellent captain.
Long Zixuan played a great role in the student incident in Hong Kong City, and Xu Yingrong was also one of the contributors.
So after Long Zixuan was promoted to police chief, he was promoted to deputy chief of the police station on Long Zixuan's recommendation.
He had been very excited these past few days. He had caught those three people tonight and wanted to do a good job.
Seeing that the time had reached three o'clock in the morning, the phone on the desk suddenly rang.
Xu Yingrong, who was lying down and sleeping, stood up, grabbed the phone and put it to his ear: "Hello, this is the police station!"
"Hello, I'm looking for Deputy Director Xu Yingrong. Is he here?"
The other party was very polite. Xu Yingrong breathed a sigh of relief. He thought something big had happened just now. He sat down and said, "I am, what can I do for you? Why are you calling at this time?"
"Xu Yingrong, you are the one I am looking for!
Do you want to hear your wife's voice? "
Suddenly a crying woman's voice came from the phone: "Ying Rong... it's me... wuwu... come and save me..."
Xu Yingrong stood up: "Who are you? Are you at my house?"
The other party sneered: "Xu Yingrong, you'd better do as I say now.
Otherwise I wouldn't mind having you receive a finger from your wife tomorrow morning! "
"You, you, you... don't mess around... you, you, what do you want?"
Xu Yingrong held the microphone nervously, a little flustered.
"What I think depends on what you do next."
"Action? What action?"
“It’s very simple, take one of the three people you arrested today, put on your police uniform and bring him out to me!
We can't let Su Can and her men who are guarding outside recognize her!
If you don't do well, then your wife will never leave my place alive! "
"You, you, you... don't mess around!
I'm telling you, if anything happens to my wife I won't let you go! "
When Xu Yingrong answered the phone, Long Zixuan came in to talk to him.
After hearing his reaction, she immediately walked to him and said in a very low voice: "What's going on?"
When Xu Yingrong didn't know how to answer, he heard the person on the phone say: "By the way, call your boss Long Zixuan over now to answer the phone, and I'll tell him good news!
